outputs.answer: Five-path model brainstorm grounded in SkillGen source evidence.

ideas.title: Landscape Gap Benchmark
ideas.hypothesis: A landscape-driven benchmark can expose adaptation gaps in generated agent skills.
ideas.approach: Build a bounded benchmark comparing generated skills against source-backed baseline tools.
ideas.novelty_hypothesis: The benchmark is novel relative to supplied external novelty evidence.

ideas.title: Incremental Verifier Ablation
ideas.hypothesis: An incremental verifier ablation can isolate which generated skill components improve inference-time behavior.
ideas.approach: Ablate verifier inputs and measure adaptation quality across tasks grounded in the local wiki.
ideas.novelty_hypothesis: The ablation is novel relative to supplied external novelty evidence.

ideas.title: Skill Memory and Verifier Fusion
ideas.hypothesis: Combining skill memory with verifier feedback improves reuse of generated agent skills.
ideas.approach: Fuse memory retrieval and verifier scoring, then compare against memory-only and verifier-only baselines.
ideas.novelty_hypothesis: The combination is novel relative to supplied external novelty evidence.

ideas.title: Adaptive Skill Audit
ideas.hypothesis: Auditing generated skills as adaptive artifacts can reveal failures hidden by static evaluation.
ideas.approach: Break the shared assumption that skill quality can be judged before deployment by adding runtime audit probes.
ideas.novelty_hypothesis: The audit framing is novel relative to supplied external novelty evidence.

ideas.title: Cross-Domain Skill Transfer Probe
ideas.hypothesis: Skill generation mechanisms from one domain can transfer to another when evidence anchors are explicit.
ideas.approach: Transfer generated skill patterns between task domains and measure failures with source-grounded probes.
ideas.novelty_hypothesis: The transfer probe is novel relative to supplied external novelty evidence.
